0. Fázis: Projekt Újrastrukturálása és Alapok Letisztázása
Törölje a következő fájlokat és mappákat a gyökérkönyvtárból:
alphafold3_next_gen.py
alphafold3_service.py
main.py
start.py
Procfile
fabric/ (a teljes mappa)
Hozzon létre egy új Python szolgáltatást a DeepMind kód számára:
Hozzon létre egy új mappát: services/alphafold-core-py
Másolja a combined.py fájlt ebbe a mappába, és nevezze át run_inference.py-ra.
Hozzon létre egy új, rétegzett mappastruktúrát a gyökérkönyvtárban:
layer0_verification/
layer1_metaprogramming/
layer2_concurrent_core/
layer3_hpc_core/
layer4_data_logic/
layer5_interface/
Mozgassa át a meglévő szolgáltatásokat az új rétegekbe:
Mozgassa a services/elixir-gateway/ tartalmát a layer2_concurrent_core/elixir_gateway/-be.
Mozgassa a services/julia-alphafold/ tartalmát a layer3_hpc_core/julia_orchestrator/-ba.
Mozgassa a services/clojure-genome/ tartalmát a layer4_data_logic/clojure_pipeline/-be.

1. Fázis: A Formális Alapok – A Megbízhatóság Garanciája
Ez a fázis nem futó szolgáltatásokat hoz létre, hanem a CI/CD (folyamatos integráció/telepítés) pipeline részét képezi. A cél a rendszer protokolljainak és kritikus algoritmusainak matematikai bizonyítása.
Protokoll Specifikáció (TLA+):
A layer0_verification/tla/ mappában hozzon létre egy JadedProtocol.tla fájlt.
Specifikálja a szolgáltatások közötti aszinkron kommunikáció állapotgépét (pl. JobSubmitted -> Processing -> JobCompleted / JobFailed).
Adatstruktúrák Formális Leírása (Isabelle/HOL, HOL Light, HOL4, PVS):
A layer0_verification/datatypes/ mappában definiálja a rendszer fő adatstruktúráit (pl. ProteinChain, AtomCoordinates) ezen eszközök formális nyelvein. Minden eszközzel egy másik struktúrát írjon le a párhuzamos használathoz.
Algoritmus-helyesség Bizonyítása (Coq, Lean 4, Agda, F):*
A layer0_verification/algorithms/ mappában implementálja a federált tanulás aggregációs algoritmusának (FedAvg) egy egyszerűsített verzióját Coq-ban és Lean 4-ben is, és bizonyítsa be a helyességét.
Natív Kód Verifikációja (Prusti, Kani, Liquid Rust, Viper, Stainless):
Hozzon létre egy layer3_hpc_core/rust_kernels mappát.
Írjon egy egyszerű Rust függvényt (pl. egy optimalizált távolságmátrix számítást).
A CI pipeline-ban futtassa a Prusti, Kani és Liquid Rust eszközöket ezen a kódon a memória- és típusbiztonság bizonyítására.
2. Fázis: A Rendszer Gerince – Konkurrens Mag és HPC Orchestrator
Cél: Egy robusztus, aszinkron, hibatűrő központi mag létrehozása, amely a számításokat vezérli.
Erlang/Elixir Konkurrens Mag (layer2_concurrent_core/):
Átnevezés és Szerepkör: A elixir_gateway szolgáltatás mostantól a jaded_core. Ez lesz a rendszer egyetlen belépési pontja.
Feladatkezelő: Implementáljon egy JobSupervisor GenServer-t Elixirben. Ez felel a bejövő predikciós kérések fogadásáért, egyedi job_id generálásáért, és a feladat állapotának követéséért (pl. submitted, msa_search, inference, completed).
Kommunikáció: Használjon RabbitMQ-t vagy Kafka-t a szolgáltatások közötti aszinkron üzenetküldésre. A JobSupervisor egy üzenetet tesz a hpc_jobs sorba, amikor új feladat érkezik.
Julia HPC Orchestrator (layer3_hpc_core/julia_orchestrator/):
Feladatfogyasztó: A Julia szolgáltatás figyelje a hpc_jobs RabbitMQ sort. Ha új feladat érkezik, felveszi azt.
Pipeline Logika:
Állapotfrissítés: Küldjön egy üzenetet a job_status sornak: job_id: ..., status: msa_search_started.
MSA/Template Keresés: Futtassa a hhblits, hmmsearch parancsokat a run() függvénnyel a megosztott adatbázisokon.
Állapotfrissítés: Küldjön üzenetet: status: inference_started.
Python Mag Hívása: Küldjön egy HTTP POST kérést a  a szekvenciával és a generált MSA/template adatokkal.
Eredmény Feldolgozása: Fogadja a PDB/CIF stringet és a konfidencia adatokat.
Adattárolás: Az eredményt mentse el egy PostgreSQL adatbázisba (lásd 3. fázis) a job_id alá.
Állapotfrissítés: Küldjön üzenetet: status: completed.
Python Inference Wrapper (services/alphafold-core-py/):
API Wrapper: Hozzon létre egy api_wrapper.py fájlt a run_inference.py mellé. Ez egy minimális FastAPI szervert futtat a 8012-es porton.
/predict Végpont: Ez a végpont fogadja a Julia által küldött JSON-t (szekvencia, MSA-k, stb.). Létrehoz egy ideiglenes könyvtárat, beleírja a bemeneti JSON-t, majd subprocess.run() segítségével meghívja a run_inference.py-t a megfelelő parancssori argumentumokkal (--json_path, --output_dir, stb.). Beolvassa az eredményfájlokat (.cif, .json) és JSON válaszként visszaadja a tartalmukat.
docker-compose.yml Frissítése:
Adja hozzá a RabbitMQ és PostgreSQL szolgáltatásokat.
Definiálja az új alphafold-core-py szolgáltatást.
Módosítsa a julia-alphafold nevét julia-orchestrator-ra.
Gondoskodjon a megosztott kötetek (/databases, /models, /results) csatolásáról a megfelelő szolgáltatásokhoz.
3. Fázis: Adat-, Logikai és Natív Rétegek Integrálása
Cél: A HPC mag kiegészítése adatfeldolgozó, tudásalapú és natív gyorsító komponensekkel.
Clojure Adatfeldolgozó Pipeline (layer4_data_logic/clojure_pipeline/):
Szerepkör: A genomikai adatok előfeldolgozása.
Integráció: A Julia orchestrator, mielőtt elindítja az MSA keresést, küldhet egy kérést a Clojure szolgáltatásnak, ami elvégzi a szekvencia validálását, tisztítását, és visszaadja a kanonikus formát.
J Statisztikai Motor (layer4_data_logic/j_engine/):
Szerepkör: A predikció utáni statisztikai elemzés.
Integráció: Miután a Julia szolgáltatás megkapta az eredményt a Pythontól, átküldheti a konfidencia adatokat (pLDDT, PAE) a J szolgáltatásnak, ami elvégzi a statisztikai kiértékelést (átlag, szórás, korrelációk) és visszaadja az eredményt, amit a Julia hozzáad a végső adathalmazhoz.
Mercury/Prolog Tudásbázis (layer4_data_logic/knowledge_base/):
Szerepkör: Biológiai kontextus biztosítása.
Integráció: A pipeline végén a Julia szolgáltatás lekérdezi a Prolog/Mercury motort a prediktált struktúra alapján (pl. "Milyen ismert funkcionális domének találhatók ebben a struktúrában?"), és a kapott annotációkat hozzáteszi az eredményhez.
Natív Gyorsítók (C, Nim, Futhark, ATS):
Szerepkör: A Julia pipeline leglassabb, tisztán algoritmikus részeinek kiváltása.
Implementáció:
C/Nim: Írja újra a távolságmátrix számítást vagy a feature transzformációkat C-ben vagy Nim-ben. Fordítsa le őket .so megosztott könyvtárként.
Futhark: A párhuzamosítható tömbműveleteket (pl. a párosítási jellemzők számítását) implementálja Futharkban, ami rendkívül hatékony GPU kódot generál.
Integráció: A Julia szolgáltatás a ccall funkcióval hívja meg ezeket a natív függvényeket a Python kód hívása előtt, drasztikusan csökkentve az előfeldolgozási időt.
4. Fázis: Frontend és Production Readiness
Cél: A rendszer felhasználói felületének véglegesítése és az éles környezethez szükséges komponensek beállítása.
JavaScript Frontend (index.html, alphafold_viewer.html):
API Hívások: A JavaScript kód mostantól az Elixir Core (/api/...) végpontjait hívja.
Aszinkron Kezelés: A feladat elküldése után a frontend kap egy job_id-t. Egy setInterval segítségével 5 másodpercenként lekérdezi a /api/jobs/{job_id}/status végpontot. Amikor a státusz completed, a /api/jobs/{job_id}/result végpontról letölti az eredményt és megjeleníti.
CI/CD Pipeline (GitHub Actions vagy hasonló):
Hozzon létre egy .github/workflows/deploy.yml fájlt.
Build & Test: Minden push eseményre a workflow futtassa le az összes szolgáltatás tesztjeit.
Verification Step: Futtassa le a layer0_verification eszközeit (Coq, Lean, TLA+, stb.). Ha bármelyik bizonyítás vagy ellenőrzés hibát jelez, a build hiúsuljon meg.
Docker Build: Sikeres tesztek és verifikáció után építse fel az összes Docker image-et.
Deployment: Tegye közzé az image-eket egy registry-ben (pl. Docker Hub, GCR) és frissítse az éles szerveren futó konténereket.
Monitorozás és Naplózás:
Minden szolgáltatás (Elixir, Julia, Python, stb.) implementáljon egy /metrics végpontot, ami Prometheus formátumú metrikákat ad vissza.
A docker-compose.yml-ben konfigurálja a Prometheus-t, hogy gyűjtse ezeket a metrikákat, és a Grafana-t, hogy megjelenítse őket egy központi dashboardon.

# JADED Multi-Language Mikroszolgáltatás Platform - Teljes Implementáció

A rendszer egy többrétegű, formálisan verifikált, nagyteljestményű AlphaFold predikciós platform, amely nyolc különböző programozási nyelvet integrál egy egységes architektúrába.

## Alkalmazás Áttekintés

A generált alkalmazás egy komplex, mikroszolgáltatás alapú rendszer, amely a következő rétegeket implementálja:

**Layer 0 - Verification**: Formális verifikációs eszközök (TLA+, Coq, Lean 4, Isabelle/HOL)
**Layer 1 - Metaprogramming**: Kódgenerálás és transzformáció eszközök  
**Layer 2 - Concurrent Core**: Elixir központi mag hibatűrő architektúrával
**Layer 3 - HPC Core**: Julia orchestrator és Rust natív gyorsítók
**Layer 4 - Data Logic**: Clojure, J, Mercury/Prolog adatfeldolgozás
**Layer 5 - Interface**: Modern web frontend és API réteg
## Rendszer Architektúra

---- MODULE JadedProtocol ----
EXTENDS Naturals, Sequences, TLC

CONSTANTS 
    MaxJobs,      \* Maximum number of concurrent jobs
    MaxRetries,   \* Maximum retry attempts
    Services      \* Set of service names

VARIABLES
    jobs,         \* Set of all jobs with their states
    messageQueue, \* Message queue between services
    serviceStates \* Current state of each service

vars == <<jobs, messageQueue, serviceStates>>

JobStates == {"submitted", "msa_search", "inference", "completed", "failed"}
ServiceStates == {"healthy", "degraded", "failed", "recovering"}

TypeOK ==
    /\ jobs \subseteq [id: Nat, state: JobStates, retries: 0..MaxRetries]
    /\ messageQueue \in Seq([from: Services, to: Services, type: STRING, payload: STRING])
    /\ serviceStates \in [Services -> ServiceStates]

Init ==
    /\ jobs = {}
    /\ messageQueue = <<>>
    /\ serviceStates = [s \in Services |-> "healthy"]

SubmitJob(jobId) ==
    /\ Cardinality(jobs) < MaxJobs
    /\ ~\E j \in jobs : j.id = jobId
    /\ jobs' = jobs \union {[id |-> jobId, state |-> "submitted", retries |-> 0]}
    /\ messageQueue' = Append(messageQueue, 
           [from |-> "client", to |-> "elixir_core", 
            type |-> "job_submit", payload |-> ToString(jobId)])
    /\ UNCHANGED serviceStates

ProcessJob(jobId) ==
    LET job == CHOOSE j \in jobs : j.id = jobId
        nextState == CASE job.state = "submitted" -> "msa_search"
                       [] job.state = "msa_search" -> "inference" 
                       [] job.state = "inference" -> "completed"
    IN
    /\ job.state \in {"submitted", "msa_search", "inference"}
    /\ jobs' = (jobs \ {job}) \union {[job EXCEPT !.state = nextState]}
    /\ messageQueue' = Append(messageQueue,
           [from |-> "julia_orchestrator", to |-> "elixir_core",
            type |-> "state_update", payload |-> nextState])
    /\ UNCHANGED serviceStates

FailJob(jobId) ==
    LET job == CHOOSE j \in jobs : j.id = jobId
    IN
    /\ job.retries < MaxRetries
    /\ job.state \in {"msa_search", "inference"}
    /\ jobs' = (jobs \ {job}) \union 
               {[job EXCEPT !.state = "submitted", !.retries = job.retries + 1]}
    /\ messageQueue' = Append(messageQueue,
           [from |-> "supervisor", to |-> "elixir_core", 
            type |-> "job_retry", payload |-> ToString(jobId)])
    /\ UNCHANGED serviceStates

ServiceFail(service) ==
    /\ serviceStates[service] = "healthy"
    /\ serviceStates' = [serviceStates EXCEPT ![service] = "failed"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jobs, messageQueue>>

ServiceRecover(service) ==
    /\ serviceStates[service] = "failed"
    /\ serviceStates' = [serviceStates EXCEPT ![service] = "recovering"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jobs, messageQueue>>

ServiceHealthy(service) ==
    /\ serviceStates[service] = "recovering"
    /\ serviceStates' = [serviceStates EXCEPT ![service] = "healthy"]
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jobs, messageQueue>>

ConsumeMessage ==
    /\ messageQueue /= <<>>
    /\ messageQueue' = Tail(messageQueue)
    /\ UNCHANGED <<jobs, serviceStates>>

Next ==
    \/ \E jobId \in 1..MaxJobs : SubmitJob(jobId)
    \/ \E jobId \in 1..MaxJobs : ProcessJob(jobId)
    \/ \E jobId \in 1..MaxJobs : FailJob(jobId)
    \/ \E service \in Services : ServiceFail(service)
    \/ \E service \in Services : ServiceRecover(service)
    \/ \E service \in Services : ServiceHealthy(service)
    \/ ConsumeMessage

Spec == Init /\ [][Next]_vars

\* Safety Properties
NoJobLoss == \A j \in jobs : j.retries <= MaxRetries => 
                (j.state = "failed" => j.retries = MaxRetries)

EventualCompletion == \A j \in jobs : j.state = "submitted" ~> 
                        (j.state = "completed" \/ j.state = "failed")

FaultTolerance == \A s \in Services : serviceStates[s] = "failed" ~>
                    serviceStates[s] = "healthy"

\* Liveness Properties  
Progress == \A j \in jobs : j.state /= "completed" ~> j.state = "completed"

(* Isabelle/HOL theory for protein structure data types *)

theory ProteinStructures
  imports Main "HOL-Library.Code_Real" "HOL-Analysis.Analysis"
begin

(* Basic types *)
type_synonym atom_id = nat
type_synonym residue_id = nat  
type_synonym chain_id = string
type_synonym coordinate = real

(* 3D coordinates *)
datatype coord3d = Coord3D coordinate coordinate coordinate

(* Atom representation *)
record atom =
  atom_id :: atom_id
  atom_name :: string
  element :: string
  coordinates :: coord3d
  occupancy :: real
  b_factor :: real

(* Residue representation *)
record residue =
  residue_id :: residue_id
  residue_name :: string
  atoms :: "atom list"
  chain :: chain_id

(* Protein chain *)
record protein_chain =
  chain_id :: chain_id
  sequence :: string
  residues :: "residue list"

(* Complete protein structure *)
record protein_structure =
  name :: string
  chains :: "protein_chain list"
  resolution :: "real option"
  experiment_type :: string

(* Distance calculation *)
fun distance3d :: "coord3d ⇒ coord3d ⇒ real" where
  "distance3d (Coord3D x1 y1 z1) (Coord3D x2 y2 z2) = 
    sqrt ((x1-x2)^2 + (y1-y2)^2 + (z1-z2)^2)"

(* Atom distance *)
fun atom_distance :: "atom ⇒ atom ⇒ real" where
  "atom_distance a1 a2 = distance3d (coordinates a1) (coordinates a2)"

(* Well-formed structure properties *)
definition valid_coordinates :: "coord3d ⇒ bool" where
  "valid_coordinates (Coord3D x y z) = 
    (¬is_infinity x ∧ ¬is_nan x ∧ 
     ¬is_infinity y ∧ ¬is_nan y ∧ 
     ¬is_infinity z ∧ ¬is_nan z)"

definition valid_atom :: "atom ⇒ bool" where
  "valid_atom a = (
    valid_coordinates (coordinates a) ∧
    occupancy a ≥ 0 ∧ occupancy a ≤ 1 ∧
    b_factor a ≥ 0 ∧
    atom_name a ≠ '''')"

definition valid_residue :: "residue ⇒ bool" where
  "valid_residue r = (
    residue_name r ≠ '''' ∧
    atoms r ≠ [] ∧
    (∀a ∈ set (atoms r). valid_atom a))"

definition valid_chain :: "protein_chain ⇒ bool" where
  "valid_chain c = (
    chain_id c ≠ '''' ∧
    sequence c ≠ '''' ∧
    residues c ≠ [] ∧
    (∀r ∈ set (residues c). valid_residue r) ∧
    length (residues c) = length (sequence c))"

definition valid_structure :: "protein_structure ⇒ bool" where
  "valid_structure s = (
    name s ≠ '''' ∧
    chains s ≠ [] ∧
    (∀c ∈ set (chains s). valid_chain c) ∧
    (case resolution s of 
      None ⇒ True 
    | Some res ⇒ res > 0))"

(* Structural properties *)
definition backbone_atoms :: "residue ⇒ atom list" where
  "backbone_atoms r = filter (λa. atom_name a ∈ {''N'', ''CA'', ''C''}) (atoms r)"

definition sidechain_atoms :: "residue ⇒ atom list" where
  "sidechain_atoms r = filter (λa. atom_name a ∉ {''N'', ''CA'', ''C'', ''O''}) (atoms r)"

(* RMSD calculation *)
fun rmsd :: "coord3d list ⇒ coord3d list ⇒ real" where
  "rmsd [] [] = 0" |
  "rmsd (c1#cs1) (c2#cs2) = 
    (let d = distance3d c1 c2 in
     sqrt ((d^2 + (rmsd cs1 cs2)^2 * length cs1) / (length cs1 + 1)))" |
  "rmsd _ _ = 0" (* Mismatched lengths *)

(* Theorems about structural properties *)
theorem distance_symmetric:
  "distance3d c1 c2 = distance3d c2 c1"
  by (cases c1; cases c2; simp add: power2_commute)

theorem distance_nonnegative:
  "distance3d c1 c2 ≥ 0"
  by (cases c1; cases c2; simp add: real_sqrt_ge_zero)

theorem distance_identity:
  "distance3d c c = 0"
  by (cases c; simp)

theorem triangle_inequality:
  "distance3d c1 c3 ≤ distance3d c1 c2 + distance3d c2 c3"
proof (cases c1; cases c2; cases c3)
  fix x1 y1 z1 x2 y2 z2 x3 y3 z3
  assume "c1 = Coord3D x1 y1 z1" "c2 = Coord3D x2 y2 z2" "c3 = Coord3D x3 y3 z3"
  then show ?thesis
    using norm_triangle_ineq[of "(x1-x3, y1-y3, z1-z3)" "(x1-x2, y1-y2, z1-z2)"]
    by simp
qed

theorem valid_structure_has_valid_chains:
  "valid_structure s ⟹ ∀c ∈ set (chains s). valid_chain c"
  unfolding valid_structure_def by simp

theorem valid_chain_has_valid_residues:
  "valid_chain c ⟹ ∀r ∈ set (residues c). valid_residue r"
  unfolding valid_chain_def by simp

end

fn generateServiceClient(comptime service: ServiceConfig) type {
    return struct {
        const Self = @This();
        
        base_url: []const u8,
        client: std.http.Client,
        allocator: Allocator,
        
        pub fn init(allocator: Allocator, host: []const u8) Self {
            const base_url = std.fmt.allocPrint(allocator, "", .{host, service.port}) catch unreachable;
            return Self{
                .base_url = base_url,
                .client = std.http.Client{ .allocator = allocator },
                .allocator = allocator,
            };
        }
        
        pub fn deinit(self: *Self) void {
            self.allocator.free(self.base_url);
            self.client.deinit();
        }
        
        // Generate methods for each endpoint
        inline for (service.endpoints) |endpoint| {
            const method_name = comptime blk: {
                var name_buf: [64]u8 = undefined;
                var stream = std.io.fixedBufferStream(&name_buf);
                const writer = stream.writer();
                
                // Convert path to method name (e.g., "/api/jobs" -> "apiJobs")
                var capitalize_next = false;
                for (endpoint.path) |char| {
                    if (char == '/' or char == ':') {
                        capitalize_next = true;
                    } else if (std.ascii.isAlphabetic(char)) {
                        if (capitalize_next) {
                            writer.writeByte(std.ascii.toUpper(char)) catch break;
                            capitalize_next = false;
                        } else {
                            writer.writeByte(char) catch break;
                        }
                    }
                }
                
                break :blk name_buf[0..stream.pos];
            };
            
            pub fn @field(Self, method_name)(self: *Self, params: anytype) ![]u8 {
                const url = try std.fmt.allocPrint(self.allocator, "{s}{s}", .{ self.base_url, endpoint.path });
                defer self.allocator.free(url);
                
                var request = try self.client.request(.{
                    .method = switch (endpoint.method) {
                        .GET => .GET,
                        .POST => .POST,
                        .PUT => .PUT,
                        .DELETE => .DELETE,
                    },
                    .url = url,
                    .headers = .{
                        .content_type = .{ .override = "application/json" },
                    },
                });
                defer request.deinit();
                
                if (@hasField(@TypeOf(params), "body")) {
                    try request.writeAll(params.body);
                }
                
                try request.finish();
                try request.wait();
                
                const body = try request.readAll(self.allocator);
                return body;
            }
        }
    };
}

defmodule JadedCore.JobSupervisor do
  @moduledoc """
  Supervisor for individual prediction jobs.
  
  Uses DynamicSupervisor to spawn JobWorker processes for each prediction task.
  Implements circuit breaker pattern and backpressure control.
  """
  
  use DynamicSupervisor
  require Logger
  
  alias JadedCore.Job
  alias JadedCore.JobWorker
  alias JadedCore.MessageQueue.Publisher
  
  # Maximum concurrent jobs
  @max_concurrent_jobs 100
  @job_timeout 3_600_000 # 1 hour in milliseconds
  
  def start_link(init_arg) do
    DynamicSupervisor.start_link(__MODULE__, init_arg, name: __MODULE__)
  end
  
  @impl true
  def init(_init_arg) do
    DynamicSupervisor.init(
      strategy: :one_for_one,
      max_children: @max_concurrent_jobs,
      max_seconds: 60,
      max_restarts: 5
    )
  end
  
  @doc """
  Submit a new prediction job.
  """
  def submit_job(job_params) do
    with {:ok, job} <- Job.create(job_params),
         {:ok, _pid} <- start_job_worker(job) do
      Logger.info("Job submitted successfully", job_id: job.id)
      
      # Publish job submission event
      Publisher.publish("job_events", "job.submitted", %{
        job_id: job.id,
        sequence: job.sequence,
        submitted_at: DateTime.utc_now()
      })
      
      {:ok, job}
    else
      {:error, :max_children} ->
        Logger.warn("Maximum concurrent jobs reached, rejecting submission")
        {:error, :system_overloaded}
        
      {:error, reason} = error ->
        Logger.error("Failed to submit job", reason: reason)
        error
    end
  end
  
  @doc """
  Get status of all running jobs.
  """
  def list_jobs do
    DynamicSupervisor.which_children(__MODULE__)
    |> Enum.map(fn {_, pid, _, _} ->
      if Process.alive?(pid) do
        JobWorker.get_status(pid)
      else
        nil
      end
    end)
    |> Enum.reject(&is_nil/1)
  end
  
  @doc """
  Get specific job status.
  """
  def get_job_status(job_id) do
    case find_job_worker(job_id) do
      {:ok, pid} -> JobWorker.get_status(pid)
      {:error, :not_found} -> Job.get_status(job_id)
    end
  end
  
  @doc """
  Cancel a running job.
  """
  def cancel_job(job_id) do
    case find_job_worker(job_id) do
      {:ok, pid} ->
        JobWorker.cancel(pid)
        DynamicSupervisor.terminate_child(__MODULE__, pid)
        
      {:error, :not_found} ->
        Logger.warn("Attempted to cancel non-existent job", job_id: job_id)
        {:error, :not_found}
    end
  end
  
  @doc """
  Health check for the job supervisor.
  """
  def health_check do
    active_jobs = DynamicSupervisor.count_children(__MODULE__)[:active]
    
    %{
      status: :healthy,
      active_jobs: active_jobs,
      max_jobs: @max_concurrent_jobs,
      capacity_usage: active_jobs / @max_concurrent_jobs * 100
    }
  end
  
  # Private functions
  
  defp start_job_worker(job) do
    child_spec = %{
      id: job.id,
      start: {JobWorker, :start_link, [job]},
      restart: :temporary,
      type: :worker,
      modules: [JobWorker]
    }
    
    case DynamicSupervisor.start_child(__MODULE__, child_spec) do
      {:ok, pid} -> 
        # Set timeout for the job
        Process.send_after(self(), {:job_timeout, job.id, pid}, @job_timeout)
        {:ok, pid}
        
      error -> error
    end
  end
  
  defp find_job_worker(job_id) do
    DynamicSupervisor.which_children(__MODULE__)
    |> Enum.find_value(fn {id, pid, _, _} ->
      if id == job_id and Process.alive?(pid) do
        {:ok, pid}
      else
        nil
      end
    end)
    |> case do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      result -> result
    end
  end
  
  # Handle job timeouts
  def handle_info({:job_timeout, job_id, pid}, state) do
    if Process.alive?(pid) do
      Logger.warn("Job timeout, terminating", job_id: job_id)
      JobWorker.timeout(pid)
      DynamicSupervisor.terminate_child(__MODULE__, pid)
      
      # Update job status in database
      Job.mark_failed(job_id, "timeout")
      
      # Publish timeout event
      Publisher.publish("job_events", "job.timeout", %{
        job_id: job_id,
        timeout_at: DateTime.utc_now()
      })
    end
    
    {:noreply, state}
  end
end

defmodule JadedCore.JobWorker do
  @moduledoc """
  Individual job worker process.
  
  Handles the lifecycle of a single prediction job through the pipeline:
  1. MSA Search (via Julia orchestrator)
  2. Structure Prediction (via AlphaFold Python core)
  3. Post-processing and result storage
  """
  
  use GenServer, restart: :temporary
  require Logger
  
  alias JadedCore.Job
  alias JadedCore.ServiceClients.{JuliaOrchestrator, AlphaFoldCore}
  alias JadedCore.MessageQueue.Publisher
  alias JadedCore.Pipeline.{MSASearch, StructurePrediction, PostProcessing}
  
  defstruct [
    :job,
    :status,
    :started_at,
    :current_step,
    :steps_completed,
    :error,
    :result
  ]
  
  @pipeline_steps [
    :validate_input,
    :msa_search,
    :structure_prediction,
    :post_processing,
    :store_result
  ]
  
  def start_link(job) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, job)
  end
  
  @impl true
  def init(job) do
    Logger.info("Starting job worker", job_id: job.id)
    
    state = %__MODULE__{
      job: job,
      status: :running,
      started_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      current_step: :validate_input,
      steps_completed: [],
      error: nil,
      result: nil
    }
    
    # Start the pipeline immediately
    send(self(), :next_step)
    
    {:ok, state}
  end
  
  # Public API
  
  def get_status(pid) do
    GenServer.call(pid, :get_status)
  end
  
  def cancel(pid) do
    GenServer.cast(pid, :cancel)
  end
  
  def timeout(pid) do
    GenServer.cast(pid, :timeout)
  end
  
  # GenServer callbacks
  
  @impl true
  def handle_call(:get_status, _from, state) do
    status = %{
      job_id: state.job.id,
      status: state.status,
      current_step: state.current_step,
      steps_completed: state.steps_completed,
      started_at: state.started_at,
      error: state.error,
      progress: calculate_progress(state)
    }
    
    {:reply, status, state}
  end
  
  @impl true
  def handle_cast(:cancel, state) do
    Logger.info("Job cancelled", job_id: state.job.id)
    
    # Update job status
    Job.mark_cancelled(state.job.id)
    
    # Publish cancellation event
    publish_status_update(state.job.id, :cancelled, "Job cancelled by user")
    
    {:stop, :normal, %{state | status: :cancelled}}
  end
  
  @impl true
  def handle_cast(:timeout, state) do
    Logger.warn("Job timeout", job_id: state.job.id)
    
    # Update job status
    Job.mark_failed(state.job.id, "timeout")
    
    # Publish timeout event
    publish_status_update(state.job.id, :failed, "Job timeout")
    
    {:stop, :normal, %{state | status: :timeout, error: "timeout"}}
  end
  
  @impl true
  def handle_info(:next_step, %{status: :running} = state) do
    case execute_current_step(state) do
      {:ok, new_state} ->
        case get_next_step(new_state.current_step) do
          nil ->
            # Pipeline completed successfully
            Logger.info("Job completed successfully", job_id: state.job.id)
            
            Job.mark_completed(state.job.id, new_state.result)
            publish_status_update(state.job.id, :completed, "Job completed successfully")
            
            {:stop, :normal, %{new_state | status: :completed}}
            
          next_step ->
            # Continue to next step
            updated_state = %{new_state | 
              current_step: next_step,
              steps_completed: [new_state.current_step | new_state.steps_completed]
            }
            
            publish_status_update(state.job.id, :running, "Step #{next_step} started")
            send(self(), :next_step)
            
            {:noreply, updated_state}
        end
        
      {:error, reason} ->
        Logger.error("Job failed", job_id: state.job.id, reason: reason, step: state.current_step)
        
        Job.mark_failed(state.job.id, reason)
        publish_status_update(state.job.id, :failed, "Step #{state.current_step} failed: #{reason}")
        
        {:stop, :normal, %{state | status: :failed, error: reason}}
    end
  end
  
  @impl true
  def handle_info(:next_step, state) do
    # Job is not in running state, ignore
    {:noreply, state}
  end
  
  # Private functions
  
  defp execute_current_step(%{current_step: :validate_input, job: job} = state) do
    Logger.debug("Validating input", job_id: job.id)
    
    case validate_protein_sequence(job.sequence) do
      :ok -> {:ok, state}
      {:error, reason} -> {:error, "Invalid sequence: #{reason}"}
    end
  end
  
  defp execute_current_step(%{current_step: :msa_search, job: job} = state) do
    Logger.debug("Starting MSA search", job_id: job.id)
    
    case MSASearch.run(job.sequence, job.id) do
      {:ok, msa_result} ->
        # Store MSA result for next step
        updated_job = %{job | msa_data: msa_result}
        {:ok, %{state | job: updated_job}}
        
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, "MSA search failed: #{reason}"}
    end
  end
  
  defp execute_current_step(%{current_step: :structure_prediction, job: job} = state) do
    Logger.debug("Starting structure prediction", job_id: job.id)
    
    case StructurePrediction.run(job.sequence, job.msa_data, job.id) do
      {:ok, prediction_result} ->
        updated_job = %{job | prediction_data: prediction_result}
        {:ok, %{state | job: updated_job}}
        
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, "Structure prediction failed: #{reason}"}
    end
  end
  
  defp execute_current_step(%{current_step: :post_processing, job: job} = state) do
    Logger.debug("Starting post-processing", job_id: job.id)
    
    case PostProcessing.run(job.prediction_data, job.id) do
      {:ok, processed_result} ->
        updated_job = %{job | processed_result: processed_result}
        {:ok, %{state | job: updated_job}}
        
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, "Post-processing failed: #{reason}"}
    end
  end
  
  defp execute_current_step(%{current_step: :store_result, job: job} = state) do
    Logger.debug("Storing result", job_id: job.id) 
    
    case Job.store_final_result(job.id, job.processed_result) do
      {:ok, _} ->
        {:ok, %{state | result: job.processed_result}}
        
      {:error, reason} ->
        {:error, "Failed to store result: #{reason}"}
    end
  end
  
  defp validate_protein_sequence(sequence) do
    cond do
      String.length(sequence) < 10 ->
        {:error, "sequence too short (minimum 10 residues)"}
        
      String.length(sequence) > 10000 ->
        {:error, "sequence too long (maximum 10000 residues)"}
        
      not Regex.match?(~r/^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]+$/i, sequence) ->
        {:error, "sequence contains invalid amino acid codes"}
        
      true ->
        :ok
    end
  end
  
  defp get_next_step(current_step) do
    current_index = Enum.find_index(@pipeline_steps, &(&1 == current_step))
    
    if current_index < length(@pipeline_steps) - 1 do
      Enum.at(@pipeline_steps, current_index + 1)
    else
      nil
    end
  end
  
  defp calculate_progress(state) do
    completed_count = length(state.steps_completed)
    total_steps = length(@pipeline_steps)
    
    case state.status do
      :completed -> 100.0
      :failed -> completed_count / total_steps * 100
      :cancelled -> completed_count / total_steps * 100
      _ -> (completed_count + 0.5) / total_steps * 100 # Add 0.5 for current step
    end
  end
  
  defp publish_status_update(job_id, status, message) do
    Publisher.publish("job_events", "job.status_updated", %{
      job_id: job_id,
      status: status,
      message: message,
      timestamp: DateTime.utc_now()
    })
  end
end

defmodule JadedCore.Job do
  @moduledoc """
  Job schema and database operations.
  """
  
  use Ecto.Schema
  import Ecto.Changeset
  import Ecto.Query
  
  alias JadedCore.Repo
  
  @primary_key {:id, :binary_id, autogenerate: true}
  @foreign_key_type :binary_id
  
  schema "jobs" do
    field :name, :string
    field :sequence, :string
    field :status, Ecto.Enum, values: [:submitted, :running, :completed, :failed, :cancelled]
    field :msa_data, :map
    field :prediction_data, :map
    field :processed_result, :map
    field :error_message, :string
    field :submitted_at, :utc_datetime
    field :started_at, :utc_datetime
    field :completed_at, :utc_datetime
    field :progress, :float, default: 0.0
    
    timestamps()
  end
  
  @doc false
  def changeset(job, attrs) do
    job
    |> cast(attrs, [:name, :sequence, :status, :msa_data, :prediction_data, 
                    :processed_result, :error_message, :submitted_at, 
                    :started_at, :completed_at, :progress])
    |> validate_required([:sequence, :status])
    |> validate_length(:sequence, min: 10, max: 10000)
    |> validate_format(:sequence, ~r/^[ACDEFGHIKLMNPQRSTVWY]+$/i, 
                       message: "contains invalid amino acid codes")
    |> validate_inclusion(:status, [:submitted, :running, :completed, :failed, :cancelled])
  end
  
  @doc """
  Create a new job.
  """
  def create(attrs) do
    %__MODULE__{}
    |> changeset(Map.put(attrs, :submitted_at, DateTime.utc_now()))
    |> changeset(Map.put_new(attrs, :status, :submitted))
    |> Repo.insert()
  end
  
  @doc """
  Get job by ID.
  """
  def get(id) do
    Repo.get(__MODULE__, id)
  end
  
  @doc """
  Get job status.
  """
  def get_status(id) do
    case get(id) do
      nil -> {:error, :not_found}
      job -> {:ok, %{
        id: job.id,
        status: job.status,
        progress: job.progress,
        submitted_at: job.submitted_at,
        started_at: job.started_at,
        completed_at: job.completed_at,
        error_message: job.error_message
      }}
    end
  end
  
  @doc """
  Mark job as started.
  """
  def mark_started(id) do
    get(id)
    |> changeset(%{
      status: :running,
      started_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      progress: 0.0
    })
    |> Repo.update()
  end
  
  @doc """
  Update job progress.
  """
  def update_progress(id, progress) do
    get(id)
    |> changeset(%{progress: progress})
    |> Repo.update()
  end
  
  @doc """
  Mark job as completed.
  """
  def mark_completed(id, result) do
    get(id)
    |> changeset(%{
      status: :completed,
      completed_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      progress: 100.0,
      processed_result: result
    })
    |> Repo.update()
  end
  
  @doc """
  Mark job as failed.
  """
  def mark_failed(id, error_message) do
    get(id)
    |> changeset(%{
      status: :failed,
      completed_at: DateTime.utc_now(),
      error_message: error_message
    })
    |> Repo.update()
  end
  
  @doc """
  Mark job as cancelled.
  """
  def mark_cancelled(id) do
    get(id)
    |> changeset(%{
      status: :cancelled,
      completed_at: DateTime.utc_now()
    })
    |> Repo.update()
  end
  
  @doc """
  Store final result.
  """
  def store_final_result(id, result) do
    get(id)
    |> changeset(%{processed_result: result})
    |> Repo.update()
  end
  
  @doc """
  List jobs with filtering and pagination.
  """
  def list(opts \\ []) do
    limit = Keyword.get(opts, :limit, 50)
    offset = Keyword.get(opts, :offset, 0)
    status = Keyword.get(opts, :status)
    
    query = from j in __MODULE__, order_by: [desc: j.submitted_at]
    
    query = 
      if status do
        where(query, [j], j.status == ^status)
      else
        query
      end
    
    query
    |> limit(^limit)
    |> offset(^offset)
    |> Repo.all()
  end
  
  @doc """
  Get job statistics.
  """
  def statistics do
    stats_query = from j in __MODULE__,
      group_by: j.status,
      select: {j.status, count(j.id)}
    
    status_counts = Repo.all(stats_query) |> Enum.into(%{})
    
    recent_jobs_query = from j in __MODULE__,
      where: j.submitted_at >= ago(1, "day"),
      select: count(j.id)
    
    recent_jobs = Repo.one(recent_jobs_query)
    
    avg_runtime_query = from j in __MODULE__,
      where: not is_nil(j.started_at) and not is_nil(j.completed_at),
      select: avg(fragment("EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (? - ?))", j.completed_at, j.started_at))
    
    avg_runtime = Repo.one(avg_runtime_query)
    
    %{
      status_counts: status_counts,
      recent_jobs_24h: recent_jobs,
      average_runtime_seconds: avg_runtime
    }
  end
end

defmodule JadedCoreWeb.API.JobController do
  use JadedCoreWeb, :controller
  
  alias JadedCore.JobSupervisor
  alias JadedCore.Job
  
  action_fallback JadedCoreWeb.FallbackController

  @doc """
  Submit a new prediction job.
  
  POST /api/jobs
  {
    "sequence": "MKFL...",
    "name": "my_protein" (optional)
  }
  """
  def create(conn, %{"sequence" => sequence} = params) do
    job_params = %{
      sequence: String.upcase(sequence),
      name: Map.get(params, "name", "Unnamed protein"),
      status: :submitted
    }
    
    case JobSupervisor.submit_job(job_params) do
      {:ok, job} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:created)
        |> render("job.json", job: job)
        
      {:error, :system_overloaded} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:service_unavailable)
        |> json(%{error: "System is currently overloaded. Please try again later."})
        
      {:error, changeset} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:unprocessable_entity)
        |> render(JadedCoreWeb.ChangesetView, "error.json", changeset: changeset)
    end
  end
  
  def create(conn, _params) do
    conn
    |> put_status(:bad_request)
    |> json(%{error: "Missing required field: sequence"})
  end

  @doc """
  Get job status.
  
  GET /api/jobs/:id/status
  """
  def status(conn, %{"id" => job_id}) do
    case JobSupervisor.get_job_status(job_id) do
      {:ok, status} ->
        render(conn, "status.json", status: status)
        
      {:error, :not_found} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:not_found)
        |> json(%{error: "Job not found"})
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Get job result.
  
  GET /api/jobs/:id/result
  """
  def result(conn, %{"id" => job_id}) do
    case Job.get(job_id) do
      nil ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:not_found)
        |> json(%{error: "Job not found"})
        
      %{status: :completed, processed_result: result} when not is_nil(result) ->
        render(conn, "result.json", result: result)
        
      %{status: :running} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:accepted)
        |> json(%{message: "Job is still running"})
        
      %{status: :failed, error_message: error} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:unprocessable_entity)
        |> json(%{error: error})
        
      %{status: :cancelled} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:gone)
        |> json(%{error: "Job was cancelled"})
        
      _ ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:accepted)
        |> json(%{message: "Job not yet completed"})
    end
  end

  @doc """
  Cancel a job.
  
  DELETE /api/jobs/:id
  """
  def cancel(conn, %{"id" => job_id}) do
    case JobSupervisor.cancel_job(job_id) do
      :ok ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:no_content)
        |> send_resp(204, "")
        
      {:error, :not_found} ->
        conn
        |> put_status(:not_found)
        |> json(%{error: "Job not found"})
    end
  end

  @doc """
  List jobs with optional filtering.
  
  GET /api/jobs?status=running&limit=20&offset=0
  """
  def index(conn, params) do
    opts = [
      status: params["status"],
      limit: parse_int(params["limit"], 50),
      offset: parse_int(params["offset"], 0)
    ]
    |> Enum.reject(fn {_, v} -> is_nil(v) end)

    supervisor_health = JobSupervisor.health_check()

    render(conn, "stats.json", stats: stats)
  end
  
  # Private helpers
  
  defp parse_int(nil, default), do: default
  defp parse_int(str, default) when is_binary(str) do
    case Integer.parse(str) do
      {int, ""} -> int
      _ -> default
    end
  end
  defp parse_int(int, _default) when is_integer(int), do: int
  defp parse_int(_, default), do: default

    # Load native distance calculation kernel
    function native_distance_matrix(coords::Matrix{Float64})::Matrix{Float64}
        n = size(coords, 2)
        result = Matrix{Float64}(undef, n, n)
        
        ccall((:distance_matrix, NATIVE_KERNELS), Cvoid,
              (Ptr{Float64}, Ptr{Float64}, Cint),
              coords, result, Cint(n))
        
        return result
    end
    
    # Load native feature extraction kernel
    function native_extract_features(msa::Matrix{UInt8})::Array{Float32, 3}
        rows, cols = size(msa)
        features = Array{Float32}(undef, rows, cols, 64)
        
        ccall((:extract_features, NATIVE_KERNELS), Cvoid,
              (Ptr{UInt8}, Ptr{Float32}, Cint, Cint),
              msa, features, Cint(rows), Cint(cols))
        
        return features
    end
    
    @info "Native kernels loaded successfully"
else
    @warn "Native kernels not available, using Julia fallbacks"
    
    # Fallback implementations
    function native_distance_matrix(coords::Matrix{Float64})::Matrix{Float64}
        n = size(coords, 2)
        distances = zeros(n, n)
        
        @inbounds for i in 1:n
            for j in i+1:n
                d = sqrt(sum((coords[:, i] .- coords[:, j]).^2))
                distances[i, j] = d
                distances[j, i] = d
            end
        end
        
        return distances
    end
    
    function native_extract_features(msa::Matrix{UInt8})::Array{Float32, 3}
        rows, cols = size(msa)
        features = zeros(Float32, rows, cols, 64)
        
        # Simple feature extraction based on amino acid properties
        aa_properties = Dict{UInt8, Vector{Float32}}(
            UInt8('A') => Float32[1.8, 0.62, 6.0, 0.0],
            UInt8('R') => Float32[-4.5, -2.53, 10.8, 1.0],
            UInt8('N') => Float32[-3.5, -0.78, 5.4, 0.0],
            UInt8('D') => Float32[-3.5, -0.90, 3.0, -1.0],
            UInt8('C') => Float32[2.5, 1.19, 5.1, 0.0],
            # ... more amino acids
        )
        
        @inbounds for i in 1:rows
            for j in 1:cols
                aa = msa[i, j]
                props = get(aa_properties, aa, zeros(Float32, 4))
                features[i, j, 1:4] = props
                
                # Add position-specific features
                features[i, j, 5] = Float32(i / rows)
                features[i, j, 6] = Float32(j / cols)
            end
        end
        
        return features
    end

module MSASearch
    using ..JuliaOrchestrator: CONFIG, LOGGER
    using BioSequences
    using FASTX
    using Logging
    
    export search_msa, parse_a3m, validate_msa
    
    function search_msa(sequence::String, job_id::String)::Dict{String, Any}
        @info "Starting MSA search" job_id=job_id sequence_length=length(sequence)
        
        # Create temporary directory for this job
        temp_dir = joinpath(CONFIG["results_path"], job_id, "msa_search")
        mkpath(temp_dir)
        
        # Write input sequence
        input_fasta = joinpath(temp_dir, "input.fasta")
        open(input_fasta, "w") do f
            println(f, ">query")
            println(f, sequence)
        end
        
        # Database paths
        uniref90_db = joinpath(CONFIG["database_path"], "uniref90.fasta")
        mgnify_db = joinpath(CONFIG["database_path"], "mgy_clusters_2022_05.fa")
        bfd_db = joinpath(CONFIG["database_path"], "bfd-first_non_consensus_sequences.fasta")
        
        results = Dict{String, Any}()
        
        try
            # Run multiple MSA searches in parallel
            @sync begin
                # UniRef90 search
                @async begin
                    @info "Running UniRef90 search" job_id=job_id
                    uniref_result = run_jackhmmer(input_fasta, uniref90_db, 
                                                  joinpath(temp_dir, "uniref90.a3m"))
                    results["uniref90"] = uniref_result
                end
                
                # MGnify search  
                @async begin
                    @info "Running MGnify search" job_id=job_id
                    mgnify_result = run_jackhmmer(input_fasta, mgnify_db,
                                                  joinpath(temp_dir, "mgnify.a3m"))
                    results["mgnify"] = mgnify_result
                end
                
                # BFD search
                @async begin
                    @info "Running BFD search" job_id=job_id
                    bfd_result = run_jackhmmer(input_fasta, bfd_db,
                                               joinpath(temp_dir, "bfd.a3m"))
                    results["bfd"] = bfd_result
                end
            end
            
            # Combine and process MSAs
            combined_msa = combine_msas([
                results["uniref90"]["msa_path"],
                results["mgnify"]["msa_path"], 
                results["bfd"]["msa_path"]
            ])
            
            # Validate combined MSA
            validation_result = validate_msa(combined_msa, sequence)
            
            final_result = Dict{String, Any}(
                "job_id" => job_id,
                "combined_msa_path" => combined_msa,
                "search_results" => results,
                "validation" => validation_result,
                "sequence_count" => count_sequences(combined_msa),
                "search_time" => time() - start_time
            )
            
            @info "MSA search completed successfully" job_id=job_id sequences=final_result["sequence_count"]
            return final_result
            
        catch e
            @error "MSA search failed" job_id=job_id error=e
            rethrow()
        finally
            # Clean up temporary files (keep final results)
            for file in ["input.fasta"]
                rm(joinpath(temp_dir, file), force=true)
            end
        end
    end
    
    function run_jackhmmer(query_fasta::String, database::String, output_a3m::String)::Dict{String, Any}
        jackhmmer_cmd = `jackhmmer --cpu 8 -A $output_a3m $query_fasta $database`
        
        start_time = time()
        result = run(jackhmmer_cmd)
        end_time = time()
        
        if result.exitcode != 0
            throw(ErrorException("Jackhmmer failed with exit code $(result.exitcode)"))
        end
        
        return Dict{String, Any}(
            "msa_path" => output_a3m,
            "database" => database,
            "runtime" => end_time - start_time,
            "exit_code" => result.exitcode
        )
    end
    
    function combine_msas(msa_paths::Vector{String})::String
        combined_path = replace(first(msa_paths), r"\.a3m$" => "_combined.a3m")
        
        sequences = Set{String}()
        headers = Vector{String}()
        
        for msa_path in msa_paths
            if isfile(msa_path)
                reader = FASTA.Reader(open(msa_path))
                for record in reader
                    header = FASTA.identifier(record)
                    sequence = String(FASTA.sequence(record))
                    
                    if sequence ∉ sequences
                        push!(sequences, sequence)
                        push!(headers, header)
                    end
                end
                close(reader)
            end
        end
        
        # Write combined MSA
        open(combined_path, "w") do f
            for (header, sequence) in zip(headers, sequences)
                println(f, ">$header")
                println(f, sequence)
            end
        end
        
        return combined_path
    end
    
    function validate_msa(msa_path::String, query_sequence::String)::Dict{String, Any}
        if !isfile(msa_path)
            return Dict{String, Any}("valid" => false, "error" => "MSA file not found")
        end
        
        try
            reader = FASTA.Reader(open(msa_path))
            records = collect(reader)
            close(reader)
            
            if isempty(records)
                return Dict{String, Any}("valid" => false, "error" => "Empty MSA")
            end
            
            # Check query sequence is first
            first_seq = String(FASTA.sequence(first(records)))
            if first_seq != query_sequence
                @warn "Query sequence mismatch in MSA"
            end
            
            # Calculate statistics
            seq_lengths = [length(FASTA.sequence(r)) for r in records]
            avg_length = mean(seq_lengths)
            length_variance = var(seq_lengths)
            
            return Dict{String, Any}(
                "valid" => true,
                "sequence_count" => length(records),
                "average_length" => avg_length,
                "length_variance" => length_variance,
                "query_match" => first_seq == query_sequence
            )
            
        catch e
            return Dict{String, Any}("valid" => false, "error" => string(e))
        end
    end
    
    function count_sequences(msa_path::String)::Int
        if !isfile(msa_path)
            return 0
        end
        
        count = 0
        open(msa_path) do f
            for line in eachline(f)
                if startswith(line, ">")
                    count += 1
                end
            end
        end
        
        return count
    end
end

# Structure prediction orchestration
module StructurePrediction
    using ..JuliaOrchestrator: CONFIG, LOGGER, PredictionResult
    using HTTP
    using JSON3
    using Logging
    
    export run_prediction, prepare_alphafold_input, parse_alphafold_output
    
    function run_prediction(sequence::String, msa_data::Dict{String, Any}, job_id::String)::PredictionResult
        @info "Starting structure prediction" job_id=job_id
        
        start_time = time()
        
        try
            # Prepare AlphaFold input
            alphafold_input = prepare_alphafold_input(sequence, msa_data, job_id)
            
            # Call AlphaFold Python service
            response = call_alphafold_service(alphafold_input)
            
            # Parse results
            result = parse_alphafold_output(response, job_id)
            
            processing_time = time() - start_time
            
            @info "Structure prediction completed" job_id=job_id time=processing_time
            
            return PredictionResult(
                job_id,
                result["pdb_content"],
                result["cif_content"], 
                result["confidence"],
                result["metadata"],
                processing_time
            )
            
        catch e
            @error "Structure prediction failed" job_id=job_id error=e
            rethrow()
        end
    end
    
    function prepare_alphafold_input(sequence::String, msa_data::Dict{String, Any}, job_id::String)::Dict{String, Any}
        # Prepare input in AlphaFold 3 JSON format
        input_data = Dict{String, Any}(
            "name" => job_id,
            "modelSeeds" => [42], # Fixed seed for reproducibility
            "sequences" => [
                Dict{String, Any}(
                    "protein" => Dict{String, Any}(
                        "id" => "A",
                        "sequence" => sequence,
                        "modifications" => [],
                        "unpairedMsa" => read_msa_file(msa_data["combined_msa_path"]),
                        "pairedMsa" => "", # Empty for now
                        "templates" => [] # No templates for now
                    )
                )
            ],
            "dialect" => "alphafold3",
            "version" => 1
        )
        
        return input_data
    end
    
    function call_alphafold_service(input_data::Dict{String, Any})::Dict{String, Any}
        url = CONFIG["alphafold_core_url"] * "/predict"
        
        headers = Dict("Content-Type" => "application/json")
        body = JSON3.write(input_data)
        
        @info "Calling AlphaFold service" url=url input_size=length(body)
        
        response = HTTP.post(url, headers, body; readtimeout=CONFIG["prediction_timeout"])
        
        if response.status != 200
            throw(ErrorException("AlphaFold service returned status $(response.status): $(String(response.body))"))
        end
        
        return JSON3.read(String(response.body))
    end
    
    function parse_alphafold_output(response::Dict{String, Any}, job_id::String)::Dict{String, Any}
        # Extract results from AlphaFold response
        return Dict{String, Any}(
            "pdb_content" => get(response, "pdb_content", ""),
            "cif_content" => get(response, "cif_content", ""),
            "confidence" => Dict{String, Any}(
                "plddt" => get(response, "plddt", Float64[]),
                "pae" => get(response, "pae", Matrix{Float64}(undef, 0, 0)),
                "max_pae" => get(response, "max_pae", 0.0)
            ),
            "metadata" => Dict{String, Any}(
                "model_version" => get(response, "model_version", "alphafold3"),
                "prediction_time" => get(response, "prediction_time", 0.0),
                "sequence_length" => get(response, "sequence_length", 0)
            )
        )
    end
    
    function read_msa_file(msa_path::String)::String
        if !isfile(msa_path)
            return ""
        end
        
        return read(msa_path, String)
    end
end

# Message queue handling
module MessageQueue
    using ..JuliaOrchestrator: CONFIG, LOGGER, PredictionJob
    using AMQPClient
    using JSON3
    using Logging
    
    export start_consumer, publish_status, publish_result
    
    function start_consumer()
        @info "Starting message queue consumer"
        
        connection = AMQP.connection(; host=CONFIG["rabbitmq_url"])
        channel = AMQP.channel(connection, AMQP.TRANSACTIONAL, true)
        
        # Declare queues
        AMQP.queue_declare(channel, "hpc_jobs", durable=true)
        AMQP.queue_declare(channel, "job_status", durable=true)
        AMQP.queue_declare(channel, "job_results", durable=true)
        
        # Set up consumer
        AMQP.basic_consume(channel, "hpc_jobs", process_job_message)
        
        @info "Message queue consumer started, waiting for jobs..."
        
        # Keep consumer running
        while true
            try
                sleep(1)
            catch InterruptException
                @info "Shutting down consumer..."
                AMQP.connection_close(connection)
                break
            end
        end
    end
    
    function process_job_message(msg)
        try
            job_data = JSON3.read(String(msg.data))
            @info "Received job message" job_id=job_data["job_id"]
            
            # Create job struct
            job = PredictionJob(
                job_data["job_id"],
                job_data["sequence"],
                get(job_data, "name", "Unnamed protein"),
                now(),
                nothing,
                nothing,
                get(job_data, "metadata", Dict{String, Any}())
            )
            
            # Process job asynchronously
            @async process_prediction_job(job)
            
            # Acknowledge message
            AMQP.basic_ack(msg.channel, msg.delivery_tag)
            
        catch e
            @error "Failed to process job message" error=e
            AMQP.basic_nack(msg.channel, msg.delivery_tag, false, false)
        end
    end
    
    function process_prediction_job(job::PredictionJob)
        @info "Processing prediction job" job_id=job.id
        
        try
            # Update status: MSA search started
            publish_status(job.id, "msa_search_started", "Starting MSA search")
            
            # Run MSA search
            msa_result = MSASearch.search_msa(job.sequence, job.id)
            updated_job = @set job.msa_data = msa_result
            
            # Update status: Structure prediction started
            publish_status(job.id, "inference_started", "Starting structure prediction")
            
            # Run structure prediction
            prediction_result = StructurePrediction.run_prediction(
                updated_job.sequence, 
                updated_job.msa_data, 
                updated_job.id

#!/usr/bin/env python3
import os
import fnmatch
from pathlib import Path

OUTPUT_FILE = "teljes_kod_osszes_fajl.txt"

EXCLUDE_DIRS = {
    "node_modules", ".git", ".hg", ".svn", ".idea", ".vscode",
    ".venv", "venv", "__pycache__", "build", "dist", "target",
    ".next", ".nuxt", ".parcel-cache", ".cache"
}

SKIP_GLOBS = [
    "*.png","*.jpg","*.jpeg","*.gif","*.webp","*.svg","*.ico",
    "*.pdf","*.zip","*.tar","*.tar.gz","*.tgz","*.7z","*.rar",
    "*.mp4","*.mp3","*.mov","*.avi","*.mkv","*.wav","*.flac",
    "*.woff","*.woff2","*.ttf","*.otf",
    "*.p12","*.pem","*.key",
    "id_rsa*","id_ed25519*",
    ".env",".env.*",
    "*serviceaccount*.json","*gcpserviceaccount*.json"
]

def should_skip(file_path: Path) -> bool:
    name = file_path.name
    p = str(file_path)
    for pat in SKIP_GLOBS:
        if fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat) or fnmatch.fnmatch(p, pat):
            return True
    return False

def mask_line(line: str) -> str:
    # Egyszerű maszkoló: KEY=VALUE -> KEY=********
    if "=" in line and len(line.split("=", 1)[0]) <= 64:
        k, v = line.split("=", 1)
        # ha gyanúsan titok jellegű a kulcsnév
        if any(s in k.upper() for s in ["KEY", "TOKEN", "SECRET", "PASSWORD", "PASS", "APIKEY", "ACCESS"]):
            return f"{k}=********\n"
    return line

def process_file(file_path: Path) -> str:
    try:
        with file_path.open("r", encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as f:
            lines = f.readlines()
    except Exception:
        return ""

    # .env és hasonlók maszkolása soronként
    if fnmatch.fnmatch(file_path.name, ".env") or fnmatch.fnmatch(file_path.name, ".env.*"):
        lines = [mask_line(ln) for ln in lines]

    content = "".join(lines)
    header = []
    header.append("----------------------------------------")
    header.append(f"FILE: {file_path}")
    try:
        size = file_path.stat().st_size
    except Exception:
        size = 0
    header.append(f"SIZE: {size} bytes")
    header.append(f"LINES: {content.count('\\n')+1}")
    header.append("")
    return "\n".join(header) + "\n" + content + ("\n" if not content.endswith("\n") else "")

def main():
    out = []
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(".", topdown=True):
        # Könyvtárak kizárása
        dirs[:] = [d for d in dirs if d not in EXCLUDE_DIRS]
        for f in files:
            p = Path(root) / f
            if should_skip(p):
                continue
            block = process_file(p)
            if block:
                out.append(block)

    with open(OUTPUT_FILE, "w", encoding="utf-8") as w:
        w.write("\n".join(out))

    print(f"Kész: {OUTPUT_FILE}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
